newsitem.title: LEBANON: Kuwait, Lebanon, Egypt aim at crosslisting.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait, Lebanon, Egypt aim at crosslisting.

text.p: Lebanon, Egypt and Kuwait signed on Wednesday an agreement to allow crosslisting of shares on each other's stock exchanges.

"Lebanon has joined today Egypt and Kuwait in this agreement to formulate crosslisting standards and clearing and settlement agreements and brokerage firms sub-agreements," Kuwait Stock Exchange President Hisham al-Utaibi told Reuters.
The agreement -- signed in coordination with the Union of Arab Stock Exchanges -- will guarantee in its first stage a free flow of updated information to investors and dealers in all three markets.
"The Arab investor will have an easier time investing, transferring and securing his investment under this legal umbrella," Utaibi said.
